    Load Scene node

    Load Scene starts a Unity asynchronous scene load and can optionally continue to another UI or Action.

    Scene settings

    Setting Description
    Reference Scene Name or Build Index
    Scene Name Name or path registered in Build Settings
    Build Index Non-negative index in Build Settings
    Load Mode Single or Additive
    Allow Scene Activation Whether the operation may activate the loaded scene
    Scene Activation Delay Unscaled delay after loading reaches the activation threshold

    The graph validates that the selected reference is non-empty or non-negative and that Activation Delay is a finite value of zero or greater. Runtime also rejects a Build Index outside SceneManager.sceneCountInBuildSettings.

    When Allow Scene Activation is disabled, the operation remains pending. Activate it later through the active navigator:

    if (UINavigatorBehaviour.Active.HasPendingSceneActivation)
    UINavigatorBehaviour.Active.ActivatePendingScene();

    Continuation timing

    Next is optional for Scene Action nodes. If connected, the graph continues as soon as the load request is started; it does not wait for the scene to finish loading. Use Unity scene callbacks or application code when later work must wait for completion.

    With Single mode, remember that loading a new scene can destroy the current UINavigatorBehaviour unless its GameObject is preserved or the destination scene provides the next navigator.
